text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан clutches victory at the
Hanshin
Daishoten.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Fans are hoping she'll enter the spring
Tenno Sho,
where she'd face off against
Райс Шоуэр, the
Sable Assassin...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Райс Шоуэр is a formidable opponent,
strong
enough to rival the likes of Mejiro
McQueen and
Михоно Бурбон.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан decides to enter the spring
Tenno
Sho without hesitation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
